```text
455	func validateEncodedOpenRequest(value string) error {
456		if value == "" || len(value) > 64<<10 {
457			return errors.New("encoded request is empty or too large")
458		}
459		decoded, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(value)
460		if err != nil {
461			return errors.New("encoded request is not unpadded base64url")
462		}
463		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(decoded))
464		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
465		var request OpenRequest
466		if err := decoder.Decode(&request); err != nil {
467			return fmt.Errorf("decode request JSON: %w", err)
468		}
469		var trailing any
470		if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
471			return errors.New("request must contain exactly one JSON value")
472		}
473		return nil
474	}

476	func encodePowerShellCommand(script string) string {
477		codeUnits := utf16.Encode([]rune(script))
478		encoded := make([]byte, len(codeUnits)*2)
479		for index, codeUnit := range codeUnits {
480			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(encoded[index*2:], codeUnit)
481		}
482		return base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(encoded)
483	}

493	func (t Transport) resolvePassword(host Host) (string, error) {
494		source := host.SSHLoginPasswordSource
495		switch host.PasswordKind() {
496		case "plain":
497			return source.Value, nil
498		case "bitwarden":
499			cmd := exec.Command("bw", "get", "password", source.Item)
500			out, err := cmd.Output()
501			if err != nil {
502				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve Bitwarden SSH password for %s: %w", host.Name, err)
503			}
504			return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), nil
505		case "prompt":
506			promptPasswordMu.Lock()
507			defer promptPasswordMu.Unlock()
508			writer := t.Err
509			if writer == nil {
510				writer = os.Stderr
511			}
512			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "SSH password for %s: ", host.Name)
513			terminal, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
514			if err != nil {
515				return "", fmt.Errorf("open terminal for SSH password: %w", err)
516			}
517			defer terminal.Close()
518			password, err := term.ReadPassword(terminal.Fd())
519			fmt.Fprintln(writer)
520			if err != nil {
521				return "", err
522			}
523			return string(password), nil
524		default:
525			return "", nil
526		}
527	}

529	type captureBuffer struct {
530		limit    int64
531		buffer   bytes.Buffer
532		exceeded bool
533	}
534	
535	func newCaptureBuffer(limit int64) *captureBuffer {
536		return &captureBuffer{limit: limit}
537	}
538	
539	func (b *captureBuffer) Write(value []byte) (int, error) {
540		remaining := b.limit - int64(b.buffer.Len())
541		if remaining > 0 {
542			keep := int64(len(value))
543			if keep > remaining {
544				keep = remaining
545			}
546			_, _ = b.buffer.Write(value[:int(keep)])
547		}
548		if int64(len(value)) > remaining {
549			b.exceeded = true
550		}
551		// Consume excess output without retaining it. The command timeout still
552		// bounds a peer that writes forever, while the parent process stays bounded.
553		return len(value), nil
554	}
555	
556	func (b *captureBuffer) Bytes() []byte {
557		return append([]byte(nil), b.buffer.Bytes()...)
558	}
559	
560	func (b *captureBuffer) Exceeded() bool { return b.exceeded }
561	
562	func effectiveLimit(configured, fallback int64) int64 {
563		if configured <= 0 {
564			return fallback
565		}
566		return configured
567	}
568	
569	func captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr *captureBuffer) string {
570		streams := make([]string, 0, 2)
571		if stdout.Exceeded() {
572			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stdout exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stdout.limit))
573		}
574		if stderr.Exceeded() {
575			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stderr exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stderr.limit))
576		}
577		return "fleet transport: remote " + strings.Join(streams, " and ")
578	}
579	
580	func boundedBytes(value []byte, limit int64) []byte {
581		if int64(len(value)) > limit {
582			value = value[:int(limit)]
583		}
584		return append([]byte(nil), value...)
585	}
586	
587	func appendBounded(current, suffix []byte, limit int64) []byte {
588		if int64(len(current)) >= limit {
589			return append([]byte(nil), current...)
590		}
591		available := limit - int64(len(current))
592		if int64(len(suffix)) > available {
593			suffix = suffix[:int(available)]
594		}
595		return append(append([]byte(nil), current...), suffix...)
596	}
597	
598	func localTransportFailure(message string) Result {
599		return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
600	}
```

```text
119	func resolveFleetOpenRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, request fleet.OpenRequest) (repo.Repo, error) {

124		var matches []repo.Repo
125		wantedIdentity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(request.RemoteIdentity)
126		for _, repository := range repositories {
127			if request.Path != "" && (sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.Path) || sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.RealPath)) {
128				return repository, nil
129			}
130			if wantedIdentity == "" {
131				continue
132			}
133			topology, topologyErr := gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
134			if topologyErr == nil && matchingSnapshotIdentity(topology, wantedIdentity) {
135				matches = append(matches, repository)
136			}
137		}
138		if len(matches) == 1 {
139			return matches[0], nil
140		}
141		if len(matches) > 1 {
142			return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("remote identity matches multiple repositories")
143		}
144		return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is no longer discoverable", request.Name)
145	}

147	func matchingSnapshotIdentity(topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) bool {
148		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
149			for _, raw := range append(append([]string{}, remote.FetchURLs...), remote.PushURLs...) {
150				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == identity {
151					return true
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		return false
156	}

158	func newFleetOpenCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
159		return &cobra.Command{
160			Use:   "open <host> <repo>",
161			Short: "Open a remote repository through Herdr or an SSH login shell",
162			Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(2),
163			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
164				cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
165				if err != nil {
166					return err
167				}
168				var host *fleet.Host
169				for index := range cfg.Hosts {
170					if cfg.Hosts[index].Name == args[0] {
171						host = &cfg.Hosts[index]
172						break
173					}
174				}
175				if host == nil {
176					return fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", args[0])
177				}
178				live := collectFleetHost(ctxOf(), *host, false)
179				if live.State != fleet.HostOK || live.Snapshot == nil {
180					return fmt.Errorf("host %s is not live: %s %s", host.Name, live.State, live.Error)
181				}
182				repository, err := selectFleetRepository(live.Snapshot.Repositories, args[1])
183				if err != nil {
184					return err
185				}
186				request := fleet.OpenRequest{Name: repository.Display, Path: repository.Path}
187				if len(repository.RemoteIdentities) > 0 {
188					request.RemoteIdentity = repository.RemoteIdentities[0]
189				}
190				encoded := encodeOpenRequest(request)
191				transport := fleet.Transport{Err: app.Err}
192				if live.Snapshot.Runtime == "herdr" && host.SSHAlias != "" && host.PasswordKind() == "none" {
193					prepared := transport.Run(ctxOf(), *host, []string{"fleet", "_open-herdr", "--request", encoded}, nil, false)
194					if prepared.ExitCode == 0 {
195						process := exec.CommandContext(ctxOf(), "herdr", "--remote", host.SSHAlias)
196						process.Stdin, process.Stdout, process.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
197						if err := process.Run(); err == nil {
198							return nil
199						} else {
200							app.warnf("Herdr remote attach failed; falling back to SSH: %v", err)
201						}
202					}
203				}
204				return transport.Interactive(ctxOf(), *host, []string{"fleet", "_shell", "--request", encoded}, live.PasswordAuth)
205			},
206		}
207	}
208	
209	func selectFleetRepository(repositories []fleet.RepoSnapshot, query string) (fleet.RepoSnapshot, error) {
210		for _, repository := range repositories {
211			if query == repository.Name || query == repository.Display || query == repository.Path {
212				return repository, nil
213			}
214			for _, identity := range repository.RemoteIdentities {
215				if query == identity {
216					return repository, nil
217				}
218			}
219		}
220		needle := strings.ToLower(query)
221		var matches []fleet.RepoSnapshot
222		for _, repository := range repositories {
223			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{repository.Name, repository.Display, repository.Path, strings.Join(repository.RemoteIdentities, " ")}, " "))
224			if strings.Contains(haystack, needle) {
225				matches = append(matches, repository)
226			}
227		}
228		switch len(matches) {
229		case 1:
230			return matches[0], nil
231		case 0:
232			return fleet.RepoSnapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("remote repository %q not found", query)
233		default:
234			return fleet.RepoSnapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("remote repository %q is ambiguous", query)
235		}
236	}

254	func newFleetSyncCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
255		var hostNames []string
256		var push, jsonOut bool
257		var remoteName string
258		cmd := &cobra.Command{
259			Use:   "sync <repo>",
260			Short: "Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts",
261			Long: `Synchronize one branch through its Git remote.
262	
263	The source checkout must be clean. Without --push, its HEAD must already equal
264	the fetched upstream. Targets fetch the matching remote and fast-forward only a
265	clean checkout of the same branch. Different branches are never switched;
266	ahead, dirty, divergent and ambiguous clones are reported without modification.`,
267			Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
268			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
269				request, source, err := prepareFleetSync(ctxOf(), app, args[0], remoteName, push)
270				if err != nil {
271					return err
272				}
273				cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
274				if err != nil {
275					return err
276				}
277				selected := map[string]bool{}
278				for _, name := range hostNames {
279					selected[name] = true
280				}
281				hosts := make([]fleet.Host, 0, len(cfg.Hosts))
282				found := map[string]bool{}
283				for _, host := range cfg.Hosts {
284					found[host.Name] = true
285					if len(selected) == 0 || selected[host.Name] {
286						hosts = append(hosts, host)
287					}
288				}
289				for name := range selected {
290					if !found[name] {
291						return fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
292					}
293				}
294				results := syncFleetHosts(ctxOf(), hosts, cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel, request)
295				if jsonOut {
296					payload := struct {
297						Source  fleet.SyncResult   `json:"source"`
298						Targets []fleet.SyncResult `json:"targets"`
299					}{Source: source, Targets: results}
300					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
301					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
302					if err := encoder.Encode(payload); err != nil {
303						return err
304					}
305				} else {
306					renderFleetSync(app, source, results)
307				}
308				for _, result := range results {
309					if !result.Success() {
310						return errors.New("fleet sync could not verify every managed checkout")
311					}
312				}
313				return nil
314			},
315		}
316		flags := cmd.Flags()
317		flags.BoolVar(&push, "push", false, "push the source branch before fan-out")
318		flags.StringVar(&remoteName, "remote", "", "Git remote to publish/check (default: upstream, then origin)")
319		flags.StringSliceVar(&hostNames, "host", nil, "only these configured host names")
320		flags.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit JSON results")
321		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeRepos(app)
322		return cmd
323	}
324	
325	func prepareFleetSync(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref, requestedRemote string, push bool) (fleet.SyncRequest, fleet.SyncResult, error) {
326		repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
327		if err != nil {
328			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
329		}
330		if repository.Bare {
331			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s is bare and has no checkout to publish", repository.Display())
332		}
333		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Path)
334		if err != nil {
335			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
336		}
337		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
338			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, errors.New("fleet sync requires an attached branch")
339		}
340		if status.Dirty() || status.Conflicted > 0 {
341			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("source checkout must be clean (%s)", status.Summary())
342		}
343		remote := requestedRemote
344		if remote == "" && status.Upstream != "" {
345			remote, _, _ = strings.Cut(status.Upstream, "/")
346		}
347		if remote == "" {
348			remote = "origin"
349		}
350		remoteURL := gitx.Remote(ctx, repository.Path, remote)
351		identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(remoteURL)
352		if identity == "" {
353			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("remote %q has no cross-host identity", remote)
354		}
355		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "fetch", "--prune", "--quiet", remote); err != nil {
356			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
357		}
358		if push {
359			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "push", "--set-upstream", remote, status.Branch); err != nil {
360				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", status.Branch, err)
361			}
362		} else {
363			remoteOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", remote+"/"+status.Branch+"^{commit}")
364			if err != nil {
365				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("fetched %s/%s is unavailable", remote, status.Branch)
366			}
367			head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
368			if err != nil {
369				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
370			}
371			if head != remoteOID {
372				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("source HEAD does not equal %s/%s after fetch; push or reconcile it first", remote, status.Branch)
373			}
374		}
375		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
376		if err != nil {
377			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
378		}
379		request := fleet.SyncRequest{RemoteIdentity: identity, Branch: status.Branch, ExpectedOID: head}
380		source := fleet.SyncResult{
381			Host: config.Hostname(), State: fleet.SyncCurrent, Repo: repository.Display(), Path: repository.Path,
382			Branch: status.Branch, Remote: remote, BeforeOID: head, AfterOID: head, ExpectedOID: head,
383		}
384		return request, source, nil
385	}
386	
387	func syncFleetHosts(ctx context.Context, hosts []fleet.Host, maxParallel int, request fleet.SyncRequest) []fleet.SyncResult {
388		if maxParallel <= 0 {
389			maxParallel = 4
390		}
391		results := make([]fleet.SyncResult, len(hosts))
392		sem := make(chan struct{}, maxParallel)
393		var wg sync.WaitGroup
394		requestJSON, _ := json.Marshal(request)
395		for index, host := range hosts {
396			wg.Add(1)
397			go func(index int, host fleet.Host) {
398				defer wg.Done()
399				sem <- struct{}{}
400				defer func() { <-sem }()
401				transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
402				response := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_sync"}, requestJSON, false)
403				result := fleet.SyncResult{Host: host.Name, Branch: request.Branch, ExpectedOID: request.ExpectedOID}
404				switch {
405				case response.ExitCode == 0:
406					if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Stdout, &result); err != nil {
407						result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncFailed, "remote dev returned invalid sync JSON"
408					}
409					result.Host = host.Name
410				case response.TimedOut || response.ExitCode == 124:
411					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncTimeout, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
412				case response.ExitCode == 127:
413					result.State = fleet.SyncNoDev
414				case response.ExitCode == 255:
415					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncUnreachable, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
416				default:
417					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncIncompatible, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
418				}
419				results[index] = result
420			}(index, host)
421		}
422		wg.Wait()
423		return results
424	}
425	
426	func renderFleetSync(app *App, source fleet.SyncResult, targets []fleet.SyncResult) {
427		style := app.outStyle()
428		table := app.newTable("HOST", "STATE", "REPO", "BRANCH", "PATH", "DETAIL")
429		table.Add(source.Host, style.hostState(string(source.State)), source.Repo, source.Branch, config.Contract(source.Path), style.dim("source"))
430		for _, result := range targets {
431			table.Add(result.Host, style.hostState(string(result.State)), dash(result.Repo), dash(result.Branch),
432				config.Contract(result.Path), style.warning(truncate(result.Error, 64)))
433		}
434		table.Render(app.Out)
435	}

445				return cfg, err

447		}
448		return cfg, nil

451	func localFleetSnapshot(ctx context.Context, app *App) (fleet.Snapshot, error) {
452		rt := app.Runtime()
453		rows, err := collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
454		if err != nil {
455			return fleet.Snapshot{}, err
456		}
457		return fleetSnapshotFromRepoRows(rows, rt.Name()), nil

459	
460	func fleetSnapshotFromRepoRows(rows []tui.RepoRow, runtimeName string) fleet.Snapshot {
461		repositories := make([]fleet.RepoSnapshot, 0, len(rows))
462		for _, row := range rows {
463			if row.IsTry() {
464				continue
465			}
466			counts := fleet.TaskCounts{}
467			for _, tracked := range row.Tasks {
468				switch tracked.State {
469				case task.Hot:
470					counts.Hot++
471				case task.Warm:
472					counts.Warm++
473				case task.Cold:
474					counts.Cold++
475				case task.Done:
476					counts.Done++
477				}
478			}
479			repositories = append(repositories, fleet.RepoSnapshot{
480				Name: row.Repo.Name, Display: row.Repo.Display(), Category: row.Repo.Category,
481				Path: row.Repo.Path, RealPath: row.Repo.RealPath, RemoteIdentities: remoteIdentities(row),
482				Branch: row.Status.Branch, Status: row.Status, LastActivity: row.LastActivity,
483				Worktrees: row.Worktrees, Tasks: counts, Live: row.Live, Runtime: row.Runtime,
484				RuntimeHandle: row.RuntimeHandle, AgentStatus: row.RuntimeStatus, Topology: row.Topology,
485			})
486		}
487		return fleet.Snapshot{
488			SchemaVersion: fleet.SnapshotSchemaVersion,
489			Host:          config.Hostname(),
490			DevVersion:    versionFromBuild(),
491			GeneratedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
492			Runtime:       runtimeName,
493			Repositories:  repositories,
494		}
495	}
496	
497	func remoteIdentities(row tui.RepoRow) []string {
498		seen := map[string]bool{}
499		var identities []string
500		for _, remote := range row.Topology.Remotes {
501			for _, raw := range append(append([]string{}, remote.FetchURLs...), remote.PushURLs...) {
502				identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw)
503				if identity != "" && !seen[identity] {
504					seen[identity] = true
505					identities = append(identities, identity)
506				}
507			}
508		}
509		sort.Strings(identities)
510		return identities
511	}

529	type fleetCollectOptions struct {
530		CachedOnly    bool
531		Hosts         map[string]bool
532		LocalSnapshot *fleet.Snapshot
533	}
534	
535	func collectFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, options fleetCollectOptions) ([]fleet.HostResult, fleet.Config, error) {
536		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
537		if err != nil {
538			return nil, cfg, err
539		}
540		var local fleet.Snapshot
541		if options.LocalSnapshot != nil {
542			local = *options.LocalSnapshot
543		} else {
544			local, err = localFleetSnapshot(ctx, app)
545			if err != nil {
546				return nil, cfg, err
547			}
548		}
549		var results []fleet.HostResult
550		if len(options.Hosts) == 0 || options.Hosts[local.Host] {
551			results = append(results, fleet.HostResult{Name: local.Host, Local: true, State: fleet.HostOK, Snapshot: &local})
552		}
553		selected := make([]fleet.Host, 0, len(cfg.Hosts))
554		found := map[string]bool{local.Host: true}
555		for _, host := range cfg.Hosts {
556			found[host.Name] = true
557			if len(options.Hosts) > 0 && !options.Hosts[host.Name] {
558				continue
559			}
560			selected = append(selected, host)
561		}
562		for name := range options.Hosts {
563			if !found[name] {
564				return nil, cfg, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
565			}
566		}
567		remoteResults := make([]fleet.HostResult, len(selected))
568		sem := make(chan struct{}, cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel)
569		var wg sync.WaitGroup
570		for index, host := range selected {
571			wg.Add(1)
572			go func(index int, host fleet.Host) {
573				defer wg.Done()
574				sem <- struct{}{}
575				defer func() { <-sem }()
576				remoteResults[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, options.CachedOnly)
577			}(index, host)
578		}
579		wg.Wait()
580		return append(results, remoteResults...), cfg, nil
581	}
582	
583	func collectFleetHost(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, cachedOnly bool) fleet.HostResult {
584		endpointID := fleet.EndpointID(host)
585		cached, cachedAt, haveCache := fleet.LoadCache(host)
586		if cachedOnly {
587			if haveCache {
588				return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostStale, Snapshot: &cached, CachedAt: &cachedAt, FromCache: true, EndpointID: endpointID}
589			}
590			return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "no cached snapshot", EndpointID: endpointID}
591		}
592		transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
593		result := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_snapshot"}, nil, false)
594		if result.ExitCode == 0 {
595			var snapshot fleet.Snapshot
596			if err := json.Unmarshal(result.Stdout, &snapshot); err == nil && snapshot.SchemaVersion == fleet.SnapshotSchemaVersion {
597				_ = fleet.SaveCacheContext(ctx, host, snapshot)
598				return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostOK, Snapshot: &snapshot, PasswordAuth: result.UsedPassword, EndpointID: endpointID}
599			}
600			return cachedFleetFailure(host, fleet.HostInvalid, "remote dev returned invalid snapshot JSON", cached, cachedAt, haveCache)
601		}
602		state := fleet.HostIncompatible
603		detail := strings.TrimSpace(string(result.Stderr))
604		switch {
605		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
606			state = fleet.HostTimeout
607		case result.ExitCode == 127:
608			state = fleet.HostNoDev
609		case result.ExitCode == 255:
610			state = fleet.HostUnreachable
611		case strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(detail), "unknown command"):
612			state = fleet.HostIncompatible
613		}
614		if detail == "" {
615			detail = fmt.Sprintf("remote command exited %d", result.ExitCode)
616		}
617		return cachedFleetFailure(host, state, detail, cached, cachedAt, haveCache)
618	}
619	
620	func cachedFleetFailure(host fleet.Host, state fleet.HostState, detail string, cached fleet.Snapshot, cachedAt time.Time, haveCache bool) fleet.HostResult {
621		if haveCache && state != fleet.HostNoDev {
622			return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostStale, Snapshot: &cached, CachedAt: &cachedAt, FromCache: true, Error: detail, EndpointID: fleet.EndpointID(host)}
623		}
624		return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: state, Error: detail, EndpointID: fleet.EndpointID(host)}
625	}

627	func newFleetListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
628		var hostNames []string
629		var repoQuery string
630		var jsonOut, cachedOnly, strict bool
631		cmd := &cobra.Command{
632			Use:   "list",
633			Short: "List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts",
634			Args:  cobra.NoArgs,
635			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
636				selected := map[string]bool{}
637				for _, name := range hostNames {
638					selected[name] = true
639				}
640				results, _, err := collectFleet(ctxOf(), app, fleetCollectOptions{CachedOnly: cachedOnly, Hosts: selected})
641				if err != nil {
642					return err
643				}
644				if jsonOut {
645					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
646					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
647					if err := encoder.Encode(results); err != nil {
648						return err
649					}
650				} else {
651					renderFleetList(app, results, repoQuery)
652				}
653				if strict && anyStrictFleetFailure(results) {
654					return errors.New("one or more fleet hosts could not be verified")
655				}
656				return nil
657			},
658		}
659		flags := cmd.Flags()
660		flags.StringSliceVar(&hostNames, "host", nil, "only these configured host names")
661		flags.StringVar(&repoQuery, "repo", "", "filter repository name, identity, branch or path")
662		flags.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit versioned JSON")
663		flags.BoolVar(&cachedOnly, "cached", false, "do not contact remote hosts")
664		flags.BoolVar(&strict, "strict", false, "fail when a host is unreachable or incompatible")
665		return cmd
666	}

668	// fleetLive keeps the placeholder neutral: an em dash means "no runtime here",
669	// which is not a success worth painting green.
670	func fleetLive(style cliStyle, live string) string {
671		if live == "" {
672			return "—"
673		}
674		return style.success(live)
675	}
676	
677	func renderFleetList(app *App, results []fleet.HostResult, query string) {
678		style := app.outStyle()
679		table := app.newTable("HOST", "STATE", "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "LATEST", "PATH")
680		needle := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
681		for _, result := range results {
682			if result.Snapshot == nil || len(result.Snapshot.Repositories) == 0 {
683				table.Add(result.Name, style.hostState(string(result.State)), "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", "—",
684					style.warning(truncate(result.Error, 42)))
685				continue
686			}
687			for _, repository := range result.Snapshot.Repositories {
688				haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{repository.Name, repository.Display, repository.Branch, repository.Path, strings.Join(repository.RemoteIdentities, " ")}, " "))
689				if needle != "" && !strings.Contains(haystack, needle) {
690					continue
691				}
692				live := ""
693				if repository.Live {
694					live = repository.Runtime
695					if repository.AgentStatus != "" {
696						live += ":" + repository.AgentStatus
697					}
698				}
699				latest := "—"
700				if !repository.LastActivity.IsZero() {
701					latest = humanAge(time.Since(repository.LastActivity))
702				}
703				table.Add(result.Name, style.hostState(string(result.State)), truncate(repository.Display, 28), truncate(repository.Branch, 22),
```

```text
25	// FileLimits is the wire representation of a target's downward-clamped

28		MaxFiles          int   `json:"max_files"`
29		MaxFileBytes      int64 `json:"max_file_bytes"`
30		MaxTotalBytes     int64 `json:"max_total_bytes"`

40		case l.MaxFileBytes <= 0:
41			return errors.New("max_file_bytes must be positive")

71		if r.SchemaVersion != ProtocolSchemaVersion {
72			return fmt.Errorf("capability schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, ProtocolSchemaVersion)
73		}
74		if r.Feature != "local-files" {

97		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {

99		}

123		if reason == "" || len(reason) > 128 {
124			return false
125		}
126		for _, character := range reason {
127			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '-' {

135	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
136	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
137	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
138		if reader == nil || target == nil {
139			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
140		}
141		if maxBytes <= 0 {
142			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
143		}
144		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
147		}
148		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
149			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
150		}
151		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
152		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
153		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
154			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
155		}
156		var extra any
157		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
158			if err == nil {
159				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
160			}
161			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}
165	
166	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
167	// before it can be handed to Transport.
168	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
169		if maxBytes <= 0 {
170			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
171		}
172		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
175		}
176		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
178		}
179		return append(data, '\n'), nil
180	}
181	
182	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
183	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
184		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
185	}
```

```text
lockx target stage 2:
// Package lockx provides cross-platform advisory filesystem locks.
//
// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
// other to get a lock.
package lockx

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir. The lock file
// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
// directory being protected. label names the caller in wrapped errors.
func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) error {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
	return WithFile(ctx, lockPath, label, operation)
}

// WithFile runs operation while holding an explicit advisory lock file. Its
// parent must already exist; no directory is created as a side effect.
func WithFile(ctx context.Context, path, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
	if operation == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
	}
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	absolutePath, err := filepath.Abs(path)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("make %s lock path absolute: %w", label, err)
	}
	canonicalParent, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(filepath.Dir(absolutePath))
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s lock parent: %w", label, err)
	}
	lockPath := filepath.Join(canonicalParent, filepath.Base(absolutePath))
	lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
			err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
		}
	}()
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return operation()
}

lockx main stage 3:
// Package lockx provides a cross-platform advisory lock over a directory.
//
// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
// other to get a lock.
package lockx

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
)

// Lease holds one acquired directory lock until Close. Close is idempotent.
type Lease struct {
	lock  *fileLock
	label string
	once  sync.Once
	err   error
}

// AcquireDir acquires the same cross-process lock used by WithDir. The lock file
// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
// directory being protected.
func AcquireDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string) (*Lease, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
	lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	return &Lease{lock: lock, label: label}, nil
}

// Close releases the acquired directory lock.
func (l *Lease) Close() error {
	if l == nil {
		return nil
	}
	l.once.Do(func() {
		if err := l.lock.Close(); err != nil {
			l.err = fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", l.label, err)
		}
	})
	return l.err
}

// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir.
func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
	if operation == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
	}
	lease, err := AcquireDir(ctx, dir, label)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { err = errors.Join(err, lease.Close()) }()
	return operation()
}
```

```text
14	func (carrier *askpassSecretCarrier) parentAfterStart() error {
15		if carrier.reader == nil {
16			return nil
17		}
18		err := carrier.reader.Close()
19		carrier.reader = nil
20		return err
21	}
22	
23	func (carrier *askpassSecretCarrier) writeSecret(secret []byte) error {
24		if carrier.writer == nil {
25			return errors.New("askpass secret pipe is closed")
26		}
27		written, writeErr := carrier.writer.Write(secret)
28		if writeErr == nil && written != len(secret) {
29			writeErr = io.ErrShortWrite
30		}
31		closeErr := carrier.writer.Close()
32		carrier.writer = nil
33		return errors.Join(writeErr, closeErr)
34	}
35	
36	func (carrier *askpassSecretCarrier) close() error {
37		var readerErr, writerErr error
38		if carrier.reader != nil {
39			readerErr = carrier.reader.Close()
40			carrier.reader = nil
41		}
42		if carrier.writer != nil {
43			writerErr = carrier.writer.Close()
44			carrier.writer = nil
45		}
46		return errors.Join(readerErr, writerErr)
47	}
```

```text
1	//go:build windows

3	package fleet

5	import (
6		"errors"

11	
12		"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
13	)
14	
15	func newAskpassSecretCarrier(cmd *exec.Cmd) (*askpassSecretCarrier, string, error) {
16		reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
17		if err != nil {
18			return nil, "", err
19		}
20		closeBoth := func() {
21			_ = reader.Close()
22			_ = writer.Close()
23		}
24		readerHandle := windows.Handle(reader.Fd())
25		if err := windows.SetHandleInformation(readerHandle, windows.HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, windows.HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT); err != nil {
26			closeBoth()
27			return nil, "", err
28		}
29		if err := windows.SetHandleInformation(windows.Handle(writer.Fd()), windows.HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0); err != nil {
30			closeBoth()
31			return nil, "", err
32		}
33		if cmd.SysProcAttr == nil {
34			cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{}
35		}
36		if cmd.SysProcAttr.NoInheritHandles {
37			closeBoth()
38			return nil, "", errors.New("askpass requires inherited handles")
39		}
40		cmd.SysProcAttr.AdditionalInheritedHandles = append(
41			cmd.SysProcAttr.AdditionalInheritedHandles,
42			syscall.Handle(readerHandle),
43		)
44		return &askpassSecretCarrier{reader: reader, writer: writer}, strconv.FormatUint(uint64(readerHandle), 10), nil
45	}
46	
47	func openAskpassSecret(identifier string) (*os.File, error) {
48		value, err := strconv.ParseUint(identifier, 10, 64)
49		if err != nil || value == 0 || windows.Handle(value) == windows.InvalidHandle {
50			return nil, errors.New("invalid inherited askpass handle")
51		}
52		file := os.NewFile(uintptr(value), "dev-fleet-askpass")
53		if file == nil {
54			return nil, errors.New("cannot open inherited askpass handle")
55		}
56		return file, nil
57	}
```

```text
237	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {
238		var selected *fleet.Host
239		for index := range cfg.Hosts {
240			if cfg.Hosts[index].Name == name {
241				if selected != nil {
242					return fleet.Host{}, errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one target")
243				}
244				copy := cfg.Hosts[index]
245				selected = &copy
246			}
247		}
248		if selected == nil {
249			return fleet.Host{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
250		}
251		return *selected, nil
252	}

254	func fleetFilePatterns(project projectconfig.Result, adHoc []string) []localfiles.Pattern {
255		var patterns []localfiles.Pattern
256		if project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
257			source, _ := project.SourceFor("local_files.include")
258			for _, value := range *project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include {
259				patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: source})
260			}
261		}
262		for _, value := range adHoc {
263			patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: "--file"})
264		}
265		return patterns
266	}

268	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
269		checkout := ""
270		if ref == "" {
271			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
272			if err != nil {
273				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
274			}
275			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
276			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
277				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
278			}
279			checkout = gitRepo.Root
280		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
281			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
282				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
283				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
284					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
285				}
286				checkout = gitRepo.Root
287			}
288		}
289		if checkout == "" {
290			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
291			if err != nil {
292				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
293			}
294			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
295			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
296				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
297			}
298			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
299		}
300		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
301		if err != nil {
302			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
303		}
304		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
305			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
306		}
307		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
308		if err != nil {
309			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
310		}
311		identity, err := localfiles.FetchRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
312		if err != nil {
313			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
314		}
315		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
316	}

321			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
322			return encoder.Encode(report)

325		for _, file := range report.Files {
326			table.Add(file.Path, fmt.Sprintf("%d", file.Size), file.Mode, string(file.State))
327		}
328		table.Render(app.Out)
329		return nil
330	}
```

```text
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {

28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.

36			return result.Stdout, nil

41		case result.ExitCode == 127:

43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable

46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
```

```go
// Package lockx provides cross-platform advisory filesystem locks.
//
// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
// other to get a lock.
package lockx

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
)

// Lease holds one acquired directory lock until Close. Close is idempotent.
type Lease struct {
	lock  *fileLock
	label string
	once  sync.Once
	err   error
}

// AcquireDir acquires the same cross-process lock used by WithDir. The lock file
// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
// directory being protected.
func AcquireDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string) (*Lease, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
	lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	return &Lease{lock: lock, label: label}, nil
}

// Close releases the acquired directory lock.
func (l *Lease) Close() error {
	if l == nil {
		return nil
	}
	l.once.Do(func() {
		if err := l.lock.Close(); err != nil {
			l.err = fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", l.label, err)
		}
	})
	return l.err
}

// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir.
func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
	if operation == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
	}
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	lease, err := AcquireDir(ctx, dir, label)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { err = errors.Join(err, lease.Close()) }()
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return operation()
}

// WithFile runs operation while holding an explicit advisory lock file. Its
// parent must already exist; no directory is created as a side effect.
func WithFile(ctx context.Context, path, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
	if operation == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
	}
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	absolutePath, err := filepath.Abs(path)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("make %s lock path absolute: %w", label, err)
	}
	canonicalParent, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(filepath.Dir(absolutePath))
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s lock parent: %w", label, err)
	}
	lockPath := filepath.Join(canonicalParent, filepath.Base(absolutePath))
	lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
			err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
		}
	}()
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return operation()
}
```
